name: 消防（设施/维保/检测）标准

map.按\"设施配置 / 维护保养 / 检测验收\"三大模块逐项自查，自动计算各模块达: Run an item-by-item self-check across three modules: facility configuration / maintenance / inspection and acceptance, automatically computing the pass rate of each module and the overall compliance rate, and outputting a hidden-hazard rectification list.
map.总体合规度 = 各项实得分 ÷ 满分 ×100%: Overall compliance = sum of item scores ÷ full marks ×100%
map.每项按合规程度评分：不合格 0 分 / 基本合格 1 分 / 合格 2 分: Each item is scored by degree of compliance: non-compliant 0 / basically compliant 1 / compliant 2
map.≥90% 合格，75-89% 基本合格，60-74% 需整改，<60% 不合格: ≥90% compliant, 75-89% basically compliant, 60-74% needs rectification, <60% non-compliant
map.本工具参照《消防法》及 GB 50016 等规范设计，不替代消防部门检查: This tool is designed with reference to the Fire Protection Law and GB 50016 and other standards, and does not replace inspection by the fire department
map.📚 深度解析：消防设施合规性自查: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Fire Facility Compliance Self-Check
map.单位每月消防安全自查，按配置、维护保养、检测验收三大部分逐项打分并留痕。: Monthly fire safety self-check at an organization, scoring each item under configuration, maintenance and inspection/acceptance and keeping a record.
map.迎接消防监督检查前做内部预检，提前发现灭火器、消火栓、报警系统的缺项。: Run an internal pre-check before a fire supervision inspection to spot deficiencies in extinguishers, hydrants and alarm systems in advance.
map.新任消防管理人用本表快速建立设施现状基线，明确整改优先级与资金投放顺序。: A newly appointed fire manager can use this form to quickly establish a baseline of facility status and set rectification priorities and funding order.
map.16 项自查的评分口径: Scoring basis for the 16 self-check items
map.每项按不合格 0 分、基本合格 1 分、合格 2 分计，16 项满分 32 分。: Each item scores 0 for non-compliant, 1 for basically compliant and 2 for compliant, giving a full mark of 32 for 16 items. For example,
map.与年检维修两项为「基本合格」、其余 14 项合格，得 30 分：系统仍判定为合规: and annual inspection maintenance are rated basically compliant while the other 14 items are compliant, giving 30 points: the system still judges it compliant, but lists the maintenance items as a priority in the rectification advice. Below 24 points usually indicates a systemic deficiency that requires immediate rectification and reporting.
map.评分结果怎么分级使用？: How should the scoring result be graded and used?
map.建议把 32 分满分换算成百分制后分层：≥90% 为良好，70%~90% 为需局: Convert the 32-point full mark to a 100-point scale and grade it: ≥90% is good, 70%~90% needs partial rectification, and below 70% (24 points) is a systemic deficiency that should be listed as a major hazard for rectification within a deadline.
map.自查能替代年度检测吗？: Can self-check replace the annual inspection?
map.不能。自查是单位内部日常管理手段，用于及时发现问题；第三方年度消防设施检测与消防: No. Self-check is an internal daily management tool for promptly spotting problems, while third-party annual fire facility inspection and fire acceptance have legal effect; the depth and responsible party differ, so they cannot substitute for each other.
map.面向企事业单位的消防设施合规性自查工具，覆盖设施配置、维护保养、检测验收三大模块: A fire facility compliance self-check tool for enterprises and institutions, covering 17 key points across the three modules of facility configuration, maintenance and inspection/acceptance, quantifying compliance and generating a hidden-hazard rectification list.
map.设施/维保/检测三模块清单式自查: Checklist self-check across the facility / maintenance / inspection modules
map.分模块达标率与总体合规度: Module pass rates and overall compliance
map.自动生成隐患整改清单: Automatically generates a hidden-hazard rectification list
map.消防安全重点单位自查: Self-check for key fire safety units
map.年度消防评估辅助: Assistance for the annual fire assessment
